python3 -c "
import requests, json

r = requests.get('https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/classification_2/classification_2.fcgi?format=json')
hierarchies = r.json()['Hierarchies']['Hierarchy']

print(f'Checking {len(hierarchies)} hierarchies...')
for h in hierarchies:
    hid = h['HID']
    sname = h.get('SourceName', '')
    res = requests.get(f'https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/classification_2/classification_2.fcgi?hid={hid}&format=json')
    if res.status_code == 200:
        data = res.json()
        hier_data = data['Hierarchies']['Hierarchy'][0]
        nodes = hier_data.get('Node', [])
        for node in nodes:
            name = str(node.get('Information', {}).get('Name', ''))
            if 'food additive status' in name.lower() or ('food additive' in name.lower() and 'ncats' in (name + sname).lower()) or 'ncats' in name.lower():
                print(f'Found in HID {hid} ({sname}): {node.get(\"NodeID\")} -> {name}')
"
